taskDescription: PML macro that extracts DbView information (elements, expression filters, attribute filters, expression columns, attribute columns) from PDMS/E3D and exports to Excel via GridControl/NETDATASOURCE.
originalSemantics: PML macro that collects all DBVW objects in the world, iterates each DbView's elements (ELEL), and collects sub-objects (EXPFIL, ATTFIL, EXPCOL, ATTCOL) scoped to $!dbView. For ATTCOL, uses handle none recovery to query ATTDEF attributes. Handles (2,442) error for expression column too-long. Imports GridControl with handle ANY, creates NETGRIDCONTROL bound to NETDATASOURCE, saves to Excel.
kbGaps: DbView sub-object types (EXPFIL, ATTFIL, EXPCOL, ATTCOL) with scoped CollectAllFor
Handle NONE for var command recovery
